macros.name: afterpreface
macros.doc: The tables of tables and figures are then produced by the ‘\afterpreface’ command, which also sets things up to start the main body (on arabic page 1).

macros.name: authornameonly
macros.doc: The author’s name without degrees earned, needed for the declaration.

macros.name: beforepreface
macros.doc: The ‘\beforepreface’ command creates the title page, a copyright page (optionally), and the table of contents.

macros.name: chaprule
macros.doc: The thickness of the rules used for the chapter headings is controlled by ‘\chaprule’ and can be set to another value, say 0 pt, by the command ‘\setlength{\chaprule}{0pt}’ in the preamble.

macros.name: copyrighttrue
macros.doc: Produce or \copyrightfalse don’t produce a ‘copyright’ page (true by default).

macros.name: copyrightyear
macros.doc: Year degree conferred, or year LaTeX’d if omitted (next year if in December).

macros.name: declaration
macros.doc: Produce the required declaration that the thesis is all the author’s own work.

macros.name: figurespagetrue
macros.doc: Produce or \figurespagefalse don’t produce a ‘List of Figures’ page (true by default).

macros.name: submitdate
macros.doc: Month and year in which submitted; date LaTeX’d if omitted.

macros.name: tablespagetrue
macros.doc: Produce or \tablespagefalse don’t produce a ‘List of Tables’ page (true by default).
